content: SoAd shall reject configurations in which the transmit properties (see SoAdTxPduCollectionSemantics) of the PDUs which are assigned to a socket connection are mixed. Furthermore all socket connnections of a socket connection group shall ei ther be refered solely by PDUs with SOAD_COLLECT_LAST_IS_BEST or solely by PDUs with SOAD_COLLECT_QUEUED semantic.
